story.text: Mr. Weston, a cheerful {WIDOWER}, has a grown son he hardly knows: Frank Churchill, brought up by a rich {AUNT} whose name he took. All Highbury longs to meet him. He writes Mrs. Weston a {HANDSOME} letter, but never comes. Mr. Woodhouse thinks wedding {CAKE} terribly {INDIGESTIBLE}, yet every child in the village is seen with a {SLICE}.
story.caption: With a slice of Mrs. Weston’s wedding-cake
